_about: GL8 (the imgProc_sm stock-versus-ORACLES divergence bank): every hunk of `diff -w --strip-trailing-cr <stock> <keeling>` for the five files, classified. stock = UIOPS-v3.1.4/joefinlon-UIOPS-ba5e67c/, keeling = <ORACLES variant tree>. Rendered as a divergence-inventory table recorded during development; checked by tests/test_imgproc_stock_divergences.py.

classes.live, stock only: a branch only the stock tree has
classes.live, oracles only: a branch only the ORACLES variant has
